stories.title: Yulu raises $93M on e-bike rentals for gig workers
new_facts: Yulu raised $93M Series C at ~$170M post-money valuation; ~95% revenue from gig-worker e-bike rentals.
Yulu targets 200,000-bike fleet in two years and faster e-bikes for new logistics use cases.
stories.line: Indian e-bike rental startup Yulu raises $93M, betting on demand from gig workers in quick-commerce delivery.

stories.title: Australia cancels poultry exhibits, begins penguin flu vaccination as H5 spreads
new_facts: Melbourne Royal Show cancels poultry exhibits due to H5 bird flu spread.
5,000 Phillip Island little penguins to be vaccinated; claimed largest wild bird vaccination program globally.
stories.line: Australian authorities cancel poultry shows and plan penguin vaccinations as H5 bird flu spreads.

stories.title: US strikes ship at Iranian blockade as Trump claims control of Hormuz
new_facts: US fired on a ship violating its blockade; Trump claims 'total control' over Hormuz; Trump hid in catering truck after assassination threat at NATO summit.

stories.title: Flanagan wins Minnesota Democratic Senate primary
new_facts: Flanagan wins Minnesota Democratic Senate primary; could become first Native woman in Senate.
Race was defined by anti-ICE anger following Trump crackdown that turned deadly and destructive.
Flanagan was backed by Bernie Sanders and Ilhan Omar in the primary.
stories.line: Progressive Democrat Peggy Flanagan won Minnesota's Senate primary, advancing to a general election race.

stories.title: Trump swapped planes in Turkey over undisclosed security threat
new_facts: Trump said the jet he boarded instead was at 'greater risk' than the decoy Air Force One.
Chuck Schumer personally demanding a full briefing on the Turkey extraction operation.
Iran knew details of Trump's Turkey stay; threat involved a shoulder-fired missile.
Trump publicly confirmed the plane switch Tuesday, attributing it to Secret Service and military advice.
Michael Wolff believes Trump himself leaked the secret plane switch story to the Washington Post.
stories.line: Trump's Secret Service switched his plane in Turkey citing a security threat; details remain classified.
